financials_interim.notes: COMPANY (standalone/holding-company-only) basis. Same period as GROUP row -- see GROUP row's notes for shared context (FX/exchange-rate backdrop, segment structure sits only at Group level). GROUP basis. Q1 FY2026/27 (three months ended 30 June 2026) vs Q1 FY2025/26 (three months ended 30 June 2025) comparative, both explicitly presented side-by-side on the face Income Statement (page 2) and Statement of Financial Position (page 4, which is unusually dated 30-Jun-25 rather than 31-Mar-26 as the comparative -- a genuine same-date-prior-year compare for the balance sheet too, not just the P&L). Two reportable segments per Note 10 (page 11): Brushware (coir/wood brushware, mops -- the core export business) and Filament and Yarn (recycled PET filament/yarn). Segment Revenue: Brushware Rs.1,017.42mn (2025: Rs.999.99mn, +1.7%); Filament and Yarn Rs.417.68mn (2025: Rs.575.37mn, -27.4%) -- the Filament and Yarn contraction, not Brushware, drives the Group's -10.8% consolidated revenue decline (Rs.1,290.49mn vs Rs.1,446.08mn). Segment Gross Profit: Brushware Rs.261.87mn (2025: Rs.258.78mn, +1.2%, margin 25.7% vs 25.9%, broadly stable); Filament and Yarn Rs.15.00mn (2025: Rs.51.66mn, -70.9%, margin collapsed to 3.6% from 9.0%) -- Filament and Yarn's margin compression (not just lower volume) is the dominant driver of the Group's -6.9% consolidated gross profit. Segment Results from Operating Activities: Brushware Rs.137.35mn (2025: Rs.132.37mn, +3.8%); Filament and Yarn Rs.(39.43)mn loss (2025: Rs.(3.64)mn loss, loss widened ~10x) -- Filament and Yarn is the sole driver of the Group's -19.2% operating profit decline to Rs.101.26mn. Net Finance (Cost)/Income swung to a Rs.133.02mn net expense (2025: Rs.64.36mn expense, +106.7% worse) -- per Note 7 (page 9), this is almost entirely an FX swing: Net Interest Expense actually IMPROVED 31.6% to Rs.34.83mn (2025: Rs.50.92mn), while Exchange Loss ballooned to Rs.98.20mn (2025: Rs.13.43mn, +631%) as LKR depreciated against USD -- closing rate Rs.336.66/USD at 30 June 2026 vs Rs.299.96/USD a year earlier (Note 6, page 8), a 12.2% YoY depreciation, and vs Rs.315.54/USD at 31 March 2026, a 6.7% depreciation within the quarter alone. CITATION CAVEAT: Note 7's column header on page 9 is printed 'USD' but the figures (e.g. 133,020) tie exactly to the Rs'000 Net Finance Income/ (Expense) line on the face Income Statement (page 2) -- treated as a source-document header labelling error, figures are Rs'000 not USD. ONE-OFF ITEM: Q1 FY2025/26's comparative benefited from a Rs.39.83mn Group Deferred Tax reversal (Note: almost entirely in the Filament and Yarn segment, Rs.39.94mn per segment note, page 11), versus a much smaller Rs.0.98mn net Deferred Tax reversal this quarter -- this alone removes Rs.38.85mn of favourable YoY comparability and is a genuine one-off/non-recurring swing, not an operating trend. tax_expense=15,842 is the NET of Income Tax Expense (16,825) and Deferred Tax Reversal (983) -- i.e. Profit Before Tax (31,761) - net tax (15,842) = (47,603), ties exactly to disclosed Profit for the Quarter. In the prior-year quarter the equivalent net figure was a NET TAX CREDIT of Rs.25,218 (Income Tax Expense 14,615 more than offset by Deferred Tax Reversal 39,833) -- i.e. the Group swung from a net tax benefit to a net tax charge YoY, which is itself part of the one-off described above. EBITDA (Note 8.1, page 9) was Rs.192.73mn (2025: Rs.216.74mn, -11.1%) -- materially less severe than the swing from a Rs.61.03mn PBT to a Rs.(31.76)mn PBT loss, confirming the FX-driven finance cost and the deferred-tax one-off (not underlying operations) are what pushed the Group to a net loss this quarter. eps_basic=eps_diluted=(0.16) (2025: 0.28), only one EPS line disclosed. Cross-check: PAT (47,603,000) / shares_in_issue (306,843,357, Note 3, page 8) = Rs.(0.1551)/share, consistent with disclosed (0.16). NAV/share 14.74 (2025: 14.14) cross-checks: Total Equity 4,522,978,000 / 306,843,357 = Rs.14.74, exact match. trade_receivables/trade_payables mapped from the combined 'Trade and Other Receivables' (1,861,061) / 'Trade and Other Payables' (507,769) lines -- these are NOT pure trade balances (include other receivables/payables not broken out), a genuine filing-level limitation, not a mapping error. short_term_borrowings=1,821,285 / long_term_borrowings=822,912 map to the Interest Bearing Loans and Borrowings current/non-current lines respectively (page 4). DISCREPANCY FLAGGED: the Statement of Cash Flow's 'Cash and Cash Equivalent at the End of the Period' is Rs.136,132k (2026) and Rs.472,545k (2025), which do NOT tie to the Statement of Financial Position's 'Cash and Bank Balances' of Rs.120,062k (2026) and Rs.474,782k (2025) -- gaps of Rs.16,070k (13.4%) and Rs.2,237k (0.5%) respectively, unexplained by any disclosed note (no cash-equivalents definition note in this filing). cash_and_equivalents is stored from the Statement of Financial Position (the balance-sheet anchor, 120,062) rather than the Cash Flow Statement figure, per project convention of using the face BS; the CF-vs-BS gap is flagged here rather than silently resolved. finance_costs/finance_income left blank -- only the net finance line is disclosed on the face P&L; Note 7 splits it into interest vs FX components (cited above in notes) but not into gross finance income vs finance costs. depreciation_amortization=91,468 = Depreciation 90,208 + Leasehold Land Amortisation 1,260 (Note 8.1 EBITDA reconciliation uses 91,468 directly, a Rs.1,260 difference from the cash-flow statement's separately-listed Rs.90,208 depreciation line -- reconciles once amortisation is added, no discrepancy).

thesis.thesis_text: BPPL Holdings PLC (coir/wood brushware & mops export, plus a recycled PET Filament and Yarn business) swung to a Rs.47.6mn Group net loss in Q1 FY2026/27 (from a Rs.86.3mn profit a year earlier) even as revenue fell a more modest 10.8% YoY to Rs.1,290.5mn. The core Brushware export segment was resilient (+1.7% revenue, +3.8% operating profit, margin stable ~25.7%), while Filament and Yarn drove the deterioration (revenue -27.4%, operating loss widening ~10x to Rs.39.4mn). Below the operating line, an Rs.98.2mn FX loss (LKR depreciating 12.2% YoY against USD) and a one-off ~Rs.41mn unfavourable deferred-tax swing versus the prior year pushed PBT into a loss, even though Group EBITDA fell only 11.1% -- a much smaller decline than the net-loss headline suggests. At Rs.17.60, P/B is a moderate 1.19x and P/E is not meaningful this quarter given the net loss (Q1 FY2026/27 filing, source_doc_id 52762).
thesis.gaps_note: Macro & Industry Outlook (10% weight) unavailable -- no macro/FX/commodity data source exists in this project; the remaining five pillars are renormalized to sum to 100% (Financial Quality 33.3%, Growth 22.2%, Valuation 22.2%, Business Quality 16.7%, Governance & Risk 5.6%). Confidence is limited: only ONE interim quarter is on file (no annual report review, no multi-period trend), no dividend data exists for BPPL, and the filing's own cash-flow-to-balance-sheet cash reconciliation does not tie out, which is a genuine, unexplained disclosure gap.

financial_quality.rationale: Group swung to a Rs.47.6mn net loss (from a Rs.86.3mn profit) but Group EBITDA fell only 11.1% YoY to Rs.192.7mn (2025: Rs.216.7mn) -- a much smaller decline than the net-loss headline, indicating the swing is dominated by below-EBITDA items: an Rs.98.2mn FX loss on LKR depreciation (net interest expense itself IMPROVED 31.6% YoY) and a ~Rs.41mn unfavourable deferred-tax base-effect versus the prior year's one-off Rs.39.8mn reversal. The filing's own Cash Flow Statement does not tie to the Balance Sheet's cash balances (a Rs.16.1mn Group gap, and a full sign-flip at Company level), an unexplained data-quality flag.

growth_outlook.rationale: Group revenue fell 10.8% YoY to Rs.1,290.5mn, but this is entirely attributable to the Filament and Yarn segment (recycled PET, -27.4% revenue, gross margin nearly halving from 8.98% to 3.59%), while the core Brushware export segment (79% of Group revenue) grew +1.7% with stable ~25.7% gross margin and +3.8% operating profit -- the underlying export franchise is intact even as a smaller diversification segment deteriorates sharply.

valuation.rationale: P/E is not meaningful this quarter given the Rs.47.6mn Group net loss (EPS Rs.(0.16)). NAV/share (Total Equity Rs.4,522,978k / 306,843,357 shares) is Rs.14.74, so at Rs.17.60 (2026-08-28) P/B is a moderate ~1.19x. As a cross-check, annualising Q1 FY2026/27 EBITDA of Rs.192.7mn (x4 = Rs.770.9mn) against an enterprise value of ~Rs.7.92bn (market cap Rs.5.40bn + net debt of ~Rs.2.52bn) implies an EV/EBITDA of ~10.3x, a reasonable multiple for an export manufacturer whose net loss is largely non-operating. No dividend data is on file for BPPL.

business_quality.rationale: Established coir/wood brushware and mops exporter (Household & Personal Products sector) with a resilient core segment (Brushware: +1.7% revenue, +3.8% operating profit, stable margin) diversified into a smaller recycled PET Filament and Yarn business that is currently underperforming sharply (operating loss widened ~10x to Rs.39.4mn). The core franchise looks sound; the diversification segment's viability is the open question.

governance_risk.rationale: No circulars/disclosures feed exists to verify board or ownership changes. A specific data-quality flag exists in this filing: the Statement of Cash Flow's period-end cash figures (Group Rs.136,132k; Company Rs.(287)k) do not tie to the Balance Sheet's cash balances (Group Rs.120,062k; Company Rs.1,008k), with no reconciling note disclosed -- a genuine, unexplained discrepancy rather than a mapping error.

key_reasons: Group net loss of Rs.47.6mn is dominated by an Rs.98.2mn FX loss on LKR depreciation (+12.2% YoY vs USD) and a ~Rs.41mn unfavourable deferred-tax base effect, not a comparable deterioration in operations -- Group EBITDA fell only 11.1% YoY

Core Brushware export segment (79% of Group revenue) grew +1.7% revenue and +3.8% operating profit with stable ~25.7% gross margin, while the smaller Filament and Yarn recycling segment is the sole source of the operating decline
P/B of ~1.19x (price Rs.17.60 vs NAV/share Rs.14.74) is a moderate multiple for an exporter whose headline loss is largely non-operating; no dividend data is on file to assess yield
watch_factors: Filament and Yarn segment's gross margin nearly halved (8.98% to 3.59%) and its operating loss widened ~10x -- if this segment does not stabilise, it could become a persistent drag on an otherwise-healthy Brushware franchise

Continued LKR depreciation against USD would keep pressuring the FX line; the trend within just this quarter was already 6.7% (315.54 to 336.66), so a further quarter of similar depreciation could produce another large FX loss

The Statement of Cash Flow's period-end cash figures do not tie to the Balance Sheet's cash balances (a Rs.16.1mn Group gap, and a full sign-flip at the Company level) with no reconciling note disclosed -- a data-quality flag worth monitoring in future filings

horizon_notes.6m: Q2 FY2026/27 will show whether the Filament and Yarn segment's margin collapse persists or reverses, and whether further LKR depreciation adds to FX losses.
horizon_notes.1y: If Brushware's resilience continues and Filament and Yarn stabilises or is restructured, Group profitability should recover toward the EBITDA trend rather than the more volatile net-income line.
horizon_notes.3y: Thesis depends on whether BPPL can either fix or exit the underperforming Filament and Yarn segment while sustaining Brushware's export competitiveness.
horizon_notes.5y: No macro/FX-cycle data source in this project to forecast a multi-year LKR/USD trajectory relevant to BPPL's export-driven cost and revenue base.

interim_updates.note_text: BPPL Holdings PLC (BPPL) swung to a Group net loss of Rs.47.60mn for Q1 FY2026/27 (quarter ended 30 June 2026), against a Rs.86.25mn profit a year earlier, even as Group Revenue fell a more modest 10.8% YoY to Rs.1,290.49mn (2025: Rs.1,446.08mn). By segment (Note 10): the Filament and Yarn segment (recycled PET filament/yarn) is the primary culprit -- its revenue fell 27.4% YoY to Rs.417.68mn (2025: Rs.575.37mn) and its gross margin nearly halved from 8.98% to 3.59%, driving segment gross profit down 70.9% to Rs.15.00mn (2025: Rs.51.66mn); its operating loss widened roughly tenfold to Rs.39.43mn (2025: Rs.3.64mn loss). The Brushware segment (coir/wood brushware and mops, the core export business) was resilient by comparison: revenue +1.7% YoY to Rs.1,017.42mn, gross profit +1.2% to Rs.261.87mn (margin broadly stable at 25.7% vs 25.9%), and operating profit +3.8% to Rs.137.35mn. Group Results from Operating Activities fell 19.2% YoY to Rs.101.26mn (2025: Rs.125.39mn), entirely attributable to the Filament and Yarn swing. Below the operating line, Net Finance Expense more than doubled to Rs.133.02mn (2025: Rs.64.36mn, +106.7%) -- but this was driven almost entirely by foreign exchange, not interest: Net Interest Expense actually improved 31.6% YoY to Rs.34.83mn (2025: Rs.50.92mn), while the Exchange Loss ballooned to Rs.98.20mn (2025: Rs.13.43mn, +631%) as the LKR depreciated against the USD from a closing rate of 299.96 at 30 June 2025 to 336.66 at 30 June 2026 (a 12.2% YoY depreciation), including a 6.7% depreciation within this quarter alone (from 315.54 at 31 March 2026). Compounding the YoY comparison, the prior-year quarter had benefited from a Rs.39.83mn Group Deferred Tax reversal (almost entirely in Filament and Yarn, Rs.39.94mn) that flipped the Group from an income tax expense into a large net tax credit of Rs.25.22mn in Q1 FY2025/26; this year the equivalent net figure is a Rs.15.84mn tax expense -- a one-off swing of roughly Rs.41.06mn in comparability terms that, together with the FX-driven finance cost, is what pushed PBT from a Rs.61.03mn profit to a Rs.31.76mn loss. Group EBITDA fell a much more modest 11.1% YoY to Rs.192.73mn (2025: Rs.216.74mn, Note 8.1), confirming the net loss is dominated by FX and tax items below EBITDA rather than a comparable deterioration in underlying operations. Notably, the standalone Company (holding-company-only) result moved in the OPPOSITE direction to the Group: Company PAT grew 20.7% YoY to Rs.24.57mn (2025: Rs.20.36mn) on Other Operating Income (management fees/dividends from subsidiaries) of Rs.42.26mn (+7.6% YoY), confirming the Group's loss is concentrated entirely within the operating subsidiaries and not at the parent level.
interim_updates.gaps_note: No QoQ comparison possible: this is the first financial_statements entry for BPPL, no prior quarter collected. Note 7's 'Net Finance Income/(Expense)' table (page 9) is headed 'USD' but its figures (e.g. 133,020) tie exactly to the Rs'000 net finance line on the face Income Statement -- a source-document header labelling error, not a currency conversion; treated as Rs'000 throughout, flagged here for future reference. finance_costs/finance_income are left blank: only a net finance line (split into interest vs FX components in Note 7, both cited in note_text) is disclosed, no gross finance income/finance costs breakdown. trade_receivables/trade_payables map to combined 'Trade and Other Receivables/Payables' lines -- the filing does not break out a pure trade-only receivable/payable figure, a genuine disclosure gap rather than a mapping choice. The Statement of Cash Flow's period-end cash figures (Group Rs.136,132k; Company Rs.(287)k, i.e. negative) do not tie to the Statement of Financial Position's 'Cash and Bank Balances' (Group Rs.120,062k; Company Rs.1,008k) -- gaps of Rs.16,070k (Group) and a full sign flip (Company), unexplained by any disclosed reconciliation note in this filing; the balance-sheet figures were used for cash_and_equivalents per project convention. No asset/liability breakdown by segment beyond the Note 10 continuation (page 12) which IS disclosed and was used only for narrative context, not stored (financial_statements table holds only Group/Company totals, not segment-level rows).
interim_updates.takeaway: BPPL's swing from an Rs.86.25mn Group profit to a Rs.47.60mn loss in Q1 FY2026/27 is concentrated almost entirely in two places: the Filament and Yarn segment, where a 27.4% revenue decline and gross margin compression from 8.98% to 3.59% widened its operating loss roughly tenfold to Rs.39.43mn, and a Rs.98.20mn FX loss on LKR depreciation (336.66 vs 299.96 against USD) that more than doubled Net Finance Expense to Rs.133.02mn even as actual interest expense fell 31.6%. The core Brushware export business remained resilient (+3.8% operating profit) and Group EBITDA fell a comparatively modest 11.1%, so the headline net-loss swing overstates the deterioration in underlying operations -- it is better read as a combination of a genuine Filament and Yarn segment problem plus an FX/one-off-tax overlay that will reverse or normalise if the rupee stabilises and the prior year's outsized deferred tax reversal is not repeated as a drag going forward.

operational_highlights: Group Revenue Rs.1,290.49mn, -10.8% YoY (2025: Rs.1,446.08mn); Group net loss Rs.47.60mn vs a Rs.86.25mn profit in Q1 FY2025/26.

Filament and Yarn segment revenue -27.4% YoY to Rs.417.68mn; gross margin fell from 8.98% to 3.59%; segment gross profit -70.9% YoY to Rs.15.00mn; operating loss widened ~10x to Rs.39.43mn (2025: Rs.3.64mn loss).
Brushware segment revenue +1.7% YoY to Rs.1,017.42mn, gross profit +1.2% to Rs.261.87mn (margin stable ~25.7-25.9%), operating profit +3.8% to Rs.137.35mn.

Net Finance Expense +106.7% YoY to Rs.133.02mn, driven by an Exchange Loss of Rs.98.20mn (2025: Rs.13.43mn, +631%) as LKR/USD closing rate moved from 299.96 to 336.66 (+12.2% YoY); Net Interest Expense itself IMPROVED 31.6% YoY to Rs.34.83mn.

One-off: prior-year quarter's Rs.39.83mn Group Deferred Tax reversal (vs Rs.0.98mn this year) flipped the net tax line from a Rs.25.22mn credit (2025) to a Rs.15.84mn expense (2026), a ~Rs.41mn swing in comparability.
Group EBITDA -11.1% YoY to Rs.192.73mn (2025: Rs.216.74mn) -- much less severe than the swing to a net loss, indicating FX and tax items below EBITDA (not operations) drove the bottom-line miss.
Standalone Company PAT +20.7% YoY to Rs.24.57mn on Other Operating Income +7.6% YoY to Rs.42.26mn -- the parent's own result improved even as the Group swung to a loss.
key_drivers: Filament and Yarn segment: revenue -27.4% YoY to Rs.417.68mn with gross margin nearly halving (8.98% to 3.59%), driving segment gross profit -70.9% to Rs.15.00mn and operating loss widening ~10x to Rs.39.43mn -- the single largest driver of the Group's operating profit decline.

FX-driven finance cost: Exchange Loss of Rs.98.20mn (2025: Rs.13.43mn, +631%) as LKR depreciated 12.2% YoY against USD (336.66 vs 299.96 closing rate) -- pushed Net Finance Expense to Rs.133.02mn (+106.7% YoY) even as underlying interest expense fell 31.6%.

One-off deferred tax comparability: Q1 FY2025/26 benefited from a Rs.39.83mn Group deferred tax reversal (mostly Filament and Yarn); this year's Rs.0.98mn reversal is far smaller, a ~Rs.38.85mn unfavourable swing embedded in the YoY tax-line comparison.
Brushware segment resilience: revenue +1.7% and operating profit +3.8% YoY, showing the core export business held up despite the Group-level loss.
